#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
dnf install -y docker
systemctl enable --now docker
set +x
SECRET_JSON=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --region ap-northeast-1 --secret-id 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:ap-northeast-1:ACCOUNT:secret:lk' --query SecretString --output text)
API_KEY=$(printf '%s' "$SECRET_JSON" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["apiKey"])')
API_SECRET=$(printf '%s' "$SECRET_JSON" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["apiSecret"])')
unset SECRET_JSON
mkdir -p /etc/livekit /etc/caddy
umask 077
cat > /etc/livekit/livekit.yaml <<EOF
port: 7880
bind_addresses: ["127.0.0.1"]
rtc:
  tcp_port: 7881
  port_range_start: 50000
  port_range_end: 60000
  use_external_ip: false
  node_ip: 203.0.113.20
keys:
  $API_KEY: $API_SECRET
logging:
  level: info
EOF
unset API_KEY API_SECRET
set -x
umask 022
cat > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile <<'EOF'
{
  auto_https disable_redirects
}
lk.example.test:443 {
  tls {
    issuer acme {
      disable_http_challenge
    }
  }
  reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:7880
}
EOF
docker run -d --name livekit --restart unless-stopped --network host --log-driver awslogs --log-opt awslogs-region=ap-northeast-1 --log-opt awslogs-group=/simul-translation/livekit --log-opt awslogs-stream=livekit -v /etc/livekit/livekit.yaml:/etc/livekit.yaml:ro livekit/livekit-server:v1.13.11 --config /etc/livekit.yaml
docker run -d --name caddy --restart unless-stopped --network host --log-driver awslogs --log-opt awslogs-region=ap-northeast-1 --log-opt awslogs-group=/simul-translation/livekit --log-opt awslogs-stream=caddy -v /etc/caddy/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro -v caddy_data:/data -v caddy_config:/config caddy:2.11.7
